    summary: "<h3>React Filter</h3>\n<p>一个功能强大的 React 筛选组件库，支持多种筛选字段类型、灵活的布局方式，以及从 searchParams 种子化筛选初始值的能力。</p>\n<h3>主要特性</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>多种筛选字段类型</strong>：支持输入框、数字区间、日期选择、日期范围、下拉选择等常用筛选类型，以及职能、行业、城市等业务选择器</li>\n<li><strong>灵活布局</strong>：支持普通筛选（横向布局）和高级筛选（垂直布局）两种模式</li>\n<li><strong>展开收起</strong>：筛选行支持展开收起功能，优化页面空间利用</li>\n<li><strong>已选值展示</strong>：自动展示已选筛选条件，支持单独删除和清空全部</li>\n<li><strong>弹出层交互</strong>：支持弹出层形式的筛选交互，确认后才生效</li>\n<li><strong>searchParams 种子</strong>：<code>useSearchParamsValue</code> 从 URL 平铺参数解析筛选初始值，可选清理已消费 key</li>\n<li><strong>稳定全局类名</strong>：根 <code>react-filter</code>，内部短类名；用 <code>.react-filter .xxx</code> / <code>FILTER_CLASS</code> 定制</li>\n<li><strong>数据格式拦截器</strong>：内置 <code>{id, name}</code> ↔ <code>{label, value}</code> 格式转换拦截器，适配 SuperSelect 场景</li>\n<li><strong>声明式值映射</strong>：提供 筛选项容器</h3>\n<p>筛选项的基础容器组件。</p>\n<h4>属性</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>label</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>筛选项标签</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>open</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>是否展开状态</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>active</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>是否激活状态（有值）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>children</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>子元素</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<hr>\n<h3>FilterLines 筛选行</h3>\n<p>筛选行组件，支持多行展开收起。</p>\n<h4>属性</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>list</td>\n<td><code>Array</code></td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>筛选项配置数组，默认支持单层数组，也兼容双层数组</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>displayLine</td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td><code>1</code></td>\n<td>双层数组模式下默认展示行数</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>visibleCountStrategy</td>\n<td><code>'asc' | 'desc'</code></td>\n<td><code>'asc'</code></td>\n<td>单层数组模式下可见项计算策略，<code>asc</code> 从少往多累加，<code>desc</code> 从多往少递减</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>label</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td><code>'筛选'</code></td>\n<td>标题</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>extra</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>额外操作区域</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>className</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>自定义类名</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<hr>\n<h3>FilterProvider 状态管理</h3>\n<p>Filter 状态管理组件，用于自定义 Filter Array) =&gt; void</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>筛选值变化回调</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>children</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode | (context) =&gt; ReactNode</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>子元素或渲染函数</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<hr>\n<h3>高阶组件</h3>\n<h4>withFilterValue</h4>\n<p>为组件注入筛选值和变更函数。</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { withFilterValue } from '@kne/react-filter';\n\nconst MyFilterItem = withFilterValue(({ name, label, value, onChange, ...props }) =&gt; {\n  return &lt;Component value={value} onChange={onChange} /&gt;;\n});\n</code></pre>\n<h4>withFieldItem</h4>\n<p>为组件包装 FilterItem 样式。</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { withFieldItem } from '@kne/react-filter';\n\nconst MyFieldItem = 数字区间筛选</h4>\n<p>数字区间输入筛选组件。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>name</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>字段名称</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>label</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>标签</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>unit</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>单位</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>min</td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>最小值</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>max</td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>最大值</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>placeholder</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>占位符</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>DatePickerFilterItem 日期筛选</h4>\n<p>日期选择筛选组件。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>name</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>字段名称</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>label</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>标签</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>picker</td>\n<td><code>'date' 类型日期范围筛选</h4>\n<p>支持按日/周/月切换的日期范围选择筛选组件。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>name</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>字段名称</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>label</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>标签</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>format</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td><code>'YYYY-MM-DD'</code></td>\n<td>日期格式</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>SuperSelectFilterItem 通用选择器筛选</h4>\n<p>基于 <code>@kne/super-select</code> value, label }&gt;</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>选项数据</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>single</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>是否单选</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>allowSelectedAll</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>是否支持全选</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>maxLength</td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>最多可选数量</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>使用示例：</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { SuperSelectFilterItem } from '@kne/react-filter';\n\n// 多选\n&lt;SuperSelectFilterItem\n  label=\"部门\"\n  options={[\n    { value: 'tech', label: '技术研发部' },\n    { value: 'product', label: '产品设计部' }\n  ]}\n/&gt;\n\n// 单选\n&lt;SuperSelectFilterItem\n  label=\"状态\"\n  single\n  options={[\n    { value: 'active', label: '启用' },\n    { value: 'inactive', label: <code>@kne/super-select-plus</code> 依赖。</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h4>SelectAddressFilterItem 城市筛选</h4>\n<p>基于 <code>@kne/super-select-plus</code> <code>@kne/super-select-plus</code> 依赖。</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h4>CityFilterItem（高级筛选）</h4>\n<p>城市选择器的高级筛选版本，用于 <code>AdvancedFilter</code> 组件的 <code>list</code> 配置中。展示热门城市标签，支持搜索选择其他城市。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>single</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>是否单选</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>maxLength</td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td><code>5</code></td>\n<td>最多可选数量</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>在高级筛选中使用：</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { AdvancedFilter } from '@kne/react-filter';\nimport { CityFilterItem } from './AdvancedFilter/fields';\n\n&lt;AdvancedFilter list={[[{ type: CityFilterItem, props: { label: '城市', single: true } }]]} /&gt;;\n</code></pre>\n<hr>\n<h3>TypeDateRangePickerField 类型日期范围选择器</h3>\n<p>支持按日/周/月切换的日期范围选择器基础组件。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>value</td>\n<td><code>{ type: string, value: [Date, Date] }</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>当前值</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>defaultValue</td>\n<td><code>{ type: string, value: [Date, Date] }</code></td>\n<td><code>{ type: 'date', value: null }</code></td>\n<td>默认值</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>onChange</td>\n<td><code>(value: object) =&gt; void</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>值变化回调</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>shortcuts</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td><code>true</code></td>\n<td>是否显示快捷选项</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>shortcutOptions</td>\n<td><code>Array&lt;{ label: string, getValue: () =&gt; [Dayjs, Dayjs] }&gt;</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>自定义快捷选项</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>value 结构：</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">interface TypeDateRangeValue {\n  type: 'date' | 'week' | 'month'; // 日期类型\n  value: [Date, Date] | null; // 日期范围 [开始时间, 结束时间]\n}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>默认快捷选项：</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>近7天：<code>dayjs().subtract(7, 'day')</code> 至今天</li>\n<li>本月：本月第一天至最后一天</li>\n<li>近三个月：<code>dayjs().subtract(3, 'month')</code> 至今天</li>\n<li>当年：本年第一天至最后一天</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>自定义快捷选项示例：</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { TypeDateRangePickerField } from '@kne/react-filter';\n\n&lt;TypeDateRangePickerField\n  shortcuts={true}\n  shortcutOptions={[\n    {\n      label: '最近一周',\n      getValue: () =&gt; [dayjs().subtract(7, 'day').startOf('day'), dayjs().endOf('day')]\n    },\n    {\n      label: '最近一月',\n      getValue: () =&gt; [dayjs().subtract(1, 'month').startOf('day'), dayjs().endOf('day')]\n    }\n  ]}\n/&gt;;\n</code></pre>\n<hr>\n<h3>SearchInput 搜索输入</h3>\n<p>搜索输入组件，适合放在列表顶部做关键词搜索。输入过程中维护本地输入值，停止输入 500ms 后自动提交筛选值；中文等输入法组合输入期间不会触发搜索，确认文本后才开始计时。按回车或点击搜索按钮会立即提交。清空后搜索会提交 <code>null</code>，用于移除该筛选条件。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>name</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>字段名称，用于写入筛选值</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>label</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>标签，用于展示已选筛选条件</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>value</td>\n<td><code>{ label: string, value: string }</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>当前搜索值</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>onChange</td>\n<td><code>(value: object | null) =&gt; void</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>搜索提交回调，清空搜索时返回 <code>null</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>placeholder</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>占位符</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>searchDelay</td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td><code>500</code></td>\n<td>自动提交搜索的防抖等待时间，单位毫秒</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>使用示例</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { SearchInput, FilterProvider, getFilterValue } from '@kne/react-filter';\n\nconst [filterValue, setFilterValue] = useState([]);\n\n&lt;FilterProvider value={filterValue} onChange={setFilterValue}&gt;\n  &lt;SearchInput name=\"keyword\" label=\"关键词\" placeholder=\"请输入关键词\" searchDelay={500} allowClear /&gt;\n&lt;/FilterProvider&gt;;\n\nconst params = getFilterValue(filterValue);\n// { keyword: 'React' }\n</code></pre>\n<hr>\n<h3>工具方法</h3>\n<h4>getFilterValue</h4>\n<p>将筛选值数组转换为参数对象。</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { getFilterValue } from '@kne/react-filter';\n\nconst filterValue = [\n  { name: 'keyword', value: { label: 'test', value: 'test' } },\n  { name: 'status', value: [{ label: '已完成', value: 'done' }] }\n];\n\nconst params = getFilterValue(filterValue);\n// { keyword: 'test', status: ['done'] }\n</code></pre>\n<hr>\n<h3>筛选值结构</h3>\n<p>筛选值数组中的每一项结构：</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-typescript\">interface FilterValueItem {\n  name: string; // 字段名称\n  label: string; // 字段标签（用于展示）\n  value:\n    | {\n        // 单个值\n        label: string; // 显示文本\n        value: any; // 实际值\n      }\n    | Array&lt;{\n        // 或多个值\n        label: string;\n        value: any;\n      }&gt;\n    | null; // 或空值\n}\n</code></pre>\n<hr>\n<h3>searchParams 相关</h3>\n<h4>useSearchParamsValue</h4>\n<p>从 <code>searchParams</code> 同步解析筛选初始值数组。不管理 Filter 的 <code>value</code> / <code>defaultValue</code> / <code>onChange</code>，由调用方自行 seed。若传入 <code>setSearchParams</code>（function），mount 后会以 <code>replace: true</code> 清除已消费的 URL key。</p>\n<p><strong>函数签名：</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">useSearchParamsValue(options): array\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>参数：</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>参数</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>必填</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>options.searchParams</td>\n<td>URL 查询参数</td>\n<td>URLSearchParams</td>\n<td>是</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>options.setSearchParams</td>\n<td>清理已消费 key；非 function 则只读</td>\n<td>function</td>\n<td>否</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>options.fields</td>\n<td><code>[{ name, label }]</code>，<code>name</code> 为 URL key 与筛选 name</td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>是</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>返回值：</strong> <code>searchParamsValue</code> 筛选值数组（可能为 <code>[]</code>）。每项形如 <code>{ name, label, value: { label: raw, value: raw } }</code>。</p>\n<p><strong>示例：</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { useSearchParamsValue } from '@kne/react-filter';\nimport { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';\n\nconst [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();\nconst searchParamsValue = useSearchParamsValue({\n  searchParams,\n  setSearchParams,\n  fields: [\n    { name: 'userId', label: '用户Id' },\n    { name: 'tenantId', label: '租户Id' }\n  ]\n});\nconst [filter, setFilter] = useState(searchParamsValue);\n// 或 &lt;Filter defaultValue={searchParamsValue} ... /&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<h4>singleSelectInterceptor</h4>\n<p>单选拦截器：<code>{id, name}</code> ↔ <code>{label, value}</code>。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>input</td>\n<td><code>Function</code></td>\n<td><code>{id, name}</code> → <code>{label, value}</code> 的转换</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>output</td>\n<td><code>Function</code></td>\n<td><code>{label, value}</code> → <code>{id, name}</code> 的转换</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>multiSelectInterceptor</h4>\n<p>多选拦截器：<code>[{id, name}]</code> ↔ <code>[{label, value}]</code>。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>input</td>\n<td><code>Function</code></td>\n<td><code>[{id, name}]</code> → <code>[{label, value}]</code> 的转换</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>output</td>\n<td><code>Function</code></td>\n<td><code>[{label, value}]</code> → <code>[{id, name}]</code> 的转换</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>filterInterceptors</h4>\n<p>拦截器集合对象。</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { filterInterceptors, singleSelectInterceptor, multiSelectInterceptor } from '@kne/react-filter';\n\n// 两种引用方式等价\nfilterInterceptors.single === singleSelectInterceptor; // true\nfilterInterceptors.multi === multiSelectInterceptor; // true\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>使用示例：</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { filterInterceptors } from '@kne/react-filter';\n\n// 在 SuperSelect 组件中使用单选拦截\n&lt;SuperSelect\n  valueKey=\"id\"\n  labelKey=\"name\"\n  interceptor={filterInterceptors.single}\n  /* ... */\n/&gt;\n\n// 多选拦截\n&lt;SuperSelect\n  valueKey=\"id\"\n  labelKey=\"name\"\n  interceptor={filterInterceptors.multi}\n  /* ... */\n/&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<hr>\n<h3>工具方法</h3>\n<h4>pickSelectValues</h4>\n<p>从筛选值中提取原始值数组。支持原始值、<code>{ value }</code> 对象、<code>{ id }</code> 对象以及它们的数组。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>参数</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>value</td>\n<td><code>any</code></td>\n<td>筛选值，支持多种格式</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { pickSelectValues } from '@kne/react-filter';\n\npickSelectValues([{ value: 1 }, { id: 2 }, '3']);\n// =&gt; ['1', '2', '3']\n\npickSelectValues({ value: 'open' });\n// =&gt; ['open']\n\npickSelectValues(null);\n// =&gt; []\n</code></pre>\n<h4>createFilterValueMapper</h4>\n<p>声明式创建 mapFilterValue 函数。<code>Filter.getFilterValue</code> 默认只读取 <code>{ value }</code>，而 SuperSelectFilterItem 等组件使用 <code>{ id, name }</code> 格式，需要额外处理。此工具通过声明字段映射规则，自动生成转换函数。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>参数</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>fieldMappers</td>\n<td><code>Object</code></td>\n<td>字段名到映射规则的映射</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>映射规则类型：</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>规则</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>'string'</code></td>\n<td>确保值为字符串类型</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>'multi'</code></td>\n<td>多选，从 filter entry 提取值数组</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>'single'</code></td>\n<td>单选，从 filter entry 提取第一个值</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>Function</code></td>\n<td>自定义转换，接收 <code>(rawValue, { entry, filter, value })</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<pre><code class=\"language-javascript\">import { createFilterValueMapper } from '@kne/react-filter';\n\nconst mapFilterValue = createFilterValueMapper({\n  id: 'string',\n  roles: 'multi',\n  tenantOrgId: 'single',\n  status: rawValue =&gt; normalizeStatus(rawValue)\n});\n\nconst filterValue = mapFilterValue(filter, Filter.getFilterValue);\n</code></pre>",

    title: "基础筛选",
    description: "使用 Filter 主组件，展示关键词、金额、日期、部门等多种筛选字段的组合使用",
    code: "const { default: Filter, fields } = _ReactFilter;\nconst {\n  InputFilterItem, NumberRangeFilterItem, DatePickerFilterItem,\n  DateRangePickerFilterItem, TypeDateRangePickerFilterItem,\n  SuperSelectFilterItem, SelectFunctionFilterItem,\n  SelectIndustryFilterItem, SelectAddressFilterItem\n} = fields;\nconst { Flex, Button, message } = antd;\nconst { useState, useRef, useEffect } = React;\n\nconst departmentOptions = [\n  { value: 'tech', label: '技术研发部' },\n  { value: 'product', label: '产品设计部' },\n  { value: 'operation', label: '运营管理部' },\n  { value: 'hr', label: '人力资源部' },\n  { value: 'finance', label: '财务部' },\n  { value: 'marketing', label: '市场营销部' }\n];\n\nconst filterList = [\n  {\n    type: InputFilterItem,\n    props: { name: 'keyword', label: '关键词', placeholder: '请输入关键词搜索' }\n  },\n  {\n    type: NumberRangeFilterItem,\n    props: { name: 'amount', label: '金额', unit: '元', min: 0, max: 999999 }\n  },\n  {\n    type: DatePickerFilterItem,\n    props: { name: 'createTime', label: '创建时间', format: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }\n  },\n  {\n    type: DateRangePickerFilterItem,\n    props: { name: 'dateRange', label: '日期范围', format: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }\n  },\n  {\n    type: TypeDateRangePickerFilterItem,\n    props: { name: 'typeDateRange', label: '快捷日期' }\n  },\n  {\n    type: SuperSelectFilterItem,\n    props: { name: 'department', label: '部门', options: departmentOptions }\n  },\n  {\n    type: SelectFunctionFilterItem,\n    props: { name: 'function', label: '职能' }\n  },\n  {\n    type: SelectIndustryFilterItem,\n    props: { name: 'industry', label: '行业' }\n  },\n  {\n    type: SelectAddressFilterItem,\n    props: { name: 'city', label: '城市' }\n  }\n];\n\nconst ContainerWidthIndicator = ({ containerRef }) => {\n  const [width, setWidth] = useState(0);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const el = containerRef.current;\n    if (!el) return undefined;\n\n    const update = () => setWidth(Math.round(el.clientWidth));\n    update();\n\n    const observer = new ResizeObserver(update);\n    observer.observe(el);\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, [containerRef]);\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#999', marginBottom: 4 }}>\n      中间容器宽度: {width}px（观察收起/更多时是否持续增大或跳动）\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n  const [filterValue, setFilterValue] = useState([]);\n  const filterContainerRef = useRef(null);\n\n  const handleSearch = () => {\n    const params = Filter.getFilterValue(filterValue);\n    message.info(`搜索参数: ${JSON.stringify(params, null, 2)}`);\n    console.log('筛选参数:', params);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16} style={{ width: '100%' }}>\n      <div style={{ width: '100%' }}>\n        <ContainerWidthIndicator containerRef={filterContainerRef} />\n        <div\n          style={{\n            width: '100%',\n            display: 'flex',\n            alignItems: 'flex-start',\n            gap: 8\n          }}\n        >\n          <Button>左侧操作</Button>\n          <div\n            ref={filterContainerRef}\n            style={{\n              flex: 1,\n              minWidth: 0,\n              overflow: 'hidden',\n              border: '1px dashed #d9d9d9',\n              borderRadius: 4\n            }}\n          >\n            <Filter value={filterValue} onChange={setFilterValue} list={filterList} />\n          </div>\n          <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={handleSearch}>\n            搜索\n          </Button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <Flex gap={8}>\n        <span>当前筛选值:</span>\n        <pre style={{ margin: 0, background: '#f5f5f5', padding: 8, borderRadius: 4, flex: 1 }}>{JSON.stringify(filterValue, null, 2)}</pre>\n      </Flex>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<BaseExample />);\n\n",

    title: "searchParamsValue",
    description: "useSearchParamsValue 从平铺 URL 参数解析筛选初始值，可选清理已消费 key；Filter value/onChange 由业务自行 seed",
    code: "const { default: Filter, fields, useSearchParamsValue, getFilterValue } = _ReactFilter;\nconst { InputFilterItem } = fields;\nconst { Flex, Typography, Card } = antd;\nconst { useState, useMemo } = React;\n\n/**\n * 示例：用 mock URLSearchParams 演示 useSearchParamsValue。\n * 真实环境请使用 react-router 的 useSearchParams。\n *\n * hook 只在首次挂载时解析一次；传入 setSearchParams 后会清理已消费 key。\n * Filter 的 value/onChange 由业务自行 seed / 管理。\n */\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n  const initialSearch = useMemo(() => {\n    const params = new URLSearchParams();\n    params.set('userId', 'u-1001');\n    params.set('tenantId', 't-88');\n    return params;\n  }, []);\n\n  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useState(initialSearch);\n\n  const searchParamsValue = useSearchParamsValue({\n    searchParams,\n    setSearchParams,\n    fields: [\n      { name: 'userId', label: '用户Id' },\n      { name: 'tenantId', label: '租户Id' }\n    ]\n  });\n\n  const [filter, setFilter] = useState(searchParamsValue);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Card size=\"small\" title=\"说明\">\n        <Typography.Paragraph style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>\n          模拟进入页时 URL 为 <Typography.Text code>?userId=u-1001&tenantId=t-88</Typography.Text>。\n          hook 同步解析为 <Typography.Text code>searchParamsValue</Typography.Text>，并用{' '}\n          <Typography.Text code>useState(searchParamsValue)</Typography.Text> seed 到 Filter。\n        </Typography.Paragraph>\n        <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">\n          传入 <Typography.Text code>setSearchParams</Typography.Text> 后，mount 会以 replace\n          清掉已消费 key（下方 URL 应变空）；之后改 URL 不会再次解析，需自行重新挂载或业务侧处理。\n        </Typography.Text>\n      </Card>\n      <Card size=\"small\" title=\"当前 URL search（模拟，strip 后）\">\n        <Typography.Text code>?{searchParams.toString() || '(已清空已消费参数)'}</Typography.Text>\n      </Card>\n      <Card size=\"small\" title=\"searchParamsValue（仅首次解析，用于 seed）\">\n        <pre style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 12 }}>{JSON.stringify(searchParamsValue, null, 2)}</pre>\n      </Card>\n      <Filter\n        value={filter}\n        onChange={value => {\n          setFilter(value);\n          console.log('filter onChange', getFilterValue(value));\n        }}\n        list={[\n          [\n            { type: InputFilterItem, props: { name: 'userId', label: '用户Id' } },\n            { type: InputFilterItem, props: { name: 'tenantId', label: '租户Id' } },\n            { type: InputFilterItem, props: { name: 'keyword', label: '关键词' } }\n          ]\n        ]}\n        displayLine={1}\n      />\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<BaseExample />);\n\n",

    title: "定制 className",
    description: "通过稳定全局类名（根 react-filter + 内部短类名）用 CSS 选择器定制 Filter 内部样式；可用 FILTER_CLASS 引用类名",
    code: "const { default: Filter, fields, FILTER_CLASS, getFilterValue } = _ReactFilter;\nconst { InputFilterItem, SuperSelectFilterItem } = fields;\nconst { Flex, Button, Typography, Card, Space } = antd;\nconst { useState, useEffect } = React;\n\nconst statusOptions = [\n  { value: 'open', label: '开启' },\n  { value: 'closed', label: '关闭' }\n];\n\n/**\n * 用稳定全局类名定制 Filter 内部样式。\n * 根：react-filter；内部短类名；选择器写 .react-filter .xxx\n */\nconst CUSTOM_CSS = `\n.demo-filter-skin.${FILTER_CLASS.root} .${FILTER_CLASS.title} {\n  padding: 12px 16px;\n  background: #f7f9fc;\n  border-bottom-color: #d6e4ff;\n}\n.demo-filter-skin.${FILTER_CLASS.root} .${FILTER_CLASS.label} {\n  color: #1d39c4;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n.demo-filter-skin.${FILTER_CLASS.root} .${FILTER_CLASS.item} {\n  border-radius: 6px;\n  border-color: #adc6ff;\n}\n.demo-filter-skin.${FILTER_CLASS.root} .${FILTER_CLASS.item}.${FILTER_CLASS.itemActive} {\n  color: #1d39c4;\n  border-color: #2f54eb;\n  background: #f0f5ff;\n}\n.demo-filter-skin.${FILTER_CLASS.root} .${FILTER_CLASS.valueDisplay} {\n  background: #fcfcff;\n}\n.demo-filter-skin.${FILTER_CLASS.root} .${FILTER_CLASS.valueTag} {\n  border-radius: 4px;\n  border-color: #adc6ff;\n  background: #f0f5ff;\n  color: #1d39c4;\n}\n.demo-filter-skin.${FILTER_CLASS.root} .${FILTER_CLASS.valueClear} {\n  border-radius: 4px;\n  color: #1d39c4;\n  border-color: #adc6ff;\n}\n`;\n\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n  const [filter, setFilter] = useState([\n    { name: 'status', label: '状态', value: { label: '开启', value: 'open' } }\n  ]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const styleEl = document.createElement('style');\n    styleEl.setAttribute('data-demo', 'filter-classname');\n    styleEl.textContent = CUSTOM_CSS;\n    document.head.appendChild(styleEl);\n    return () => {\n      styleEl.remove();\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Card size=\"small\" title=\"说明\">\n        <Typography.Paragraph style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>\n          根挂 <Typography.Text code>{FILTER_CLASS.root}</Typography.Text>\n          ，内部短类名如 <Typography.Text code>{FILTER_CLASS.title}</Typography.Text> /{' '}\n          <Typography.Text code>{FILTER_CLASS.item}</Typography.Text>。用{' '}\n          <Typography.Text code>.{FILTER_CLASS.root} .{FILTER_CLASS.item}</Typography.Text> 定制。\n        </Typography.Paragraph>\n        <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">\n          本示例额外加了 <Typography.Text code>demo-filter-skin</Typography.Text> 作为页面作用域，避免污染其他示例。\n        </Typography.Text>\n      </Card>\n      <Filter\n        className=\"demo-filter-skin\"\n        value={filter}\n        onChange={setFilter}\n        list={[\n          [\n            { type: InputFilterItem, props: { name: 'keyword', label: '关键词', placeholder: '搜索' } },\n            {\n              type: SuperSelectFilterItem,\n              props: {\n                name: 'status',\n                label: '状态',\n                single: true,\n                isPopup: true,\n                options: statusOptions\n              }\n            },\n            { type: InputFilterItem, props: { name: 'owner', label: '负责人' } }\n          ]\n        ]}\n        displayLine={1}\n        extra={\n          <Button\n            type=\"primary\"\n            onClick={() => {\n              console.log(getFilterValue(filter));\n            }}\n          >\n            搜索\n          </Button>\n        }\n      />\n      <Space>\n        <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">当前筛选参数：</Typography.Text>\n        <Typography.Text code>{JSON.stringify(getFilterValue(filter))}</Typography.Text>\n      </Space>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<BaseExample />);\n\n",

    title: "高级筛选",
    description: "使用 AdvancedFilter 组件实现更复杂的筛选布局",
    code: "const { AdvancedFilter } = _ReactFilter;\nconst { InputFilterItem, ListFilterItem, CityFilterItem } = AdvancedFilter.fields;\nconst { Flex, Button, message } = antd;\nconst { useState } = React;\n\nconst AdvancedFilterExample = () => {\n  const [filterValue, setFilterValue] = useState([]);\n\n  const handleSearch = () => {\n    const params = {};\n    filterValue.forEach(item => {\n      params[item.name] = Array.isArray(item.value)\n        ? item.value.map(v => v.value)\n        : item.value?.value;\n    });\n    message.info(`搜索参数: ${JSON.stringify(params, null, 2)}`);\n    console.log('筛选参数:', params);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <AdvancedFilter\n        value={filterValue}\n        onChange={setFilterValue}\n        list={[\n          [\n            {\n              type: InputFilterItem,\n              props: {\n                name: 'name',\n                label: '姓名'\n              }\n            },\n            {\n              type: InputFilterItem,\n              props: {\n                name: 'phone',\n                label: '手机号'\n              }\n            }\n          ],\n          [\n            {\n              type: ListFilterItem,\n              props: {\n                name: 'status',\n                label: '状态',\n                single: true,\n                items: [\n                  { label: '待处理', value: 'pending' },\n                  { label: '处理中', value: 'processing' },\n                  { label: '已完成', value: 'completed' },\n                  { label: '已取消', value: 'cancelled' }\n                ]\n              }\n            }\n          ],\n          [\n            {\n              type: ListFilterItem,\n              props: {\n                name: 'tags',\n                label: '标签',\n                single: false,\n                maxLength: 3,\n                items: [\n                  { label: '前端', value: 'frontend' },\n                  { label: '后端', value: 'backend' },\n                  { label: '全栈', value: 'fullstack' },\n                  { label: 'UI设计', value: 'ui' },\n                  { label: '产品', value: 'product' }\n                ]\n              }\n            }\n          ],\n          [\n            {\n              type: CityFilterItem,\n              props: {\n                name: 'city',\n                label: '城市',\n                maxLength: 3\n              }\n            }\n          ]\n        ]}\n      />\n      <Flex justify=\"end\">\n        <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={handleSearch}>\n          查询\n        </Button>\n      </Flex>\n      <Flex gap={8}>\n        <span>当前筛选值:</span>\n        <pre style={{ margin: 0, background: '#f5f5f5', padding: 8, borderRadius: 4, flex: 1 }}>\n          {JSON.stringify(filterValue, null, 2)}\n        </pre>\n      </Flex>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<AdvancedFilterExample />);\n\n",

    title: "搜索输入",
    description: "使用 SearchInput 实现顶部关键词搜索，输入停止 500ms 后自动提交筛选值，输入法组合输入完成后才开始触发搜索",
    code: "const { SearchInput, FilterProvider, getFilterValue } = _ReactFilter;\nconst { Flex, Button, Typography, message } = antd;\nconst { useState } = React;\n\nconst SearchInputExample = () => {\n  const [filterValue, setFilterValue] = useState([]);\n\n  const handleSearch = () => {\n    const params = getFilterValue(filterValue);\n    message.info(`搜索参数: ${JSON.stringify(params)}`);\n    console.log('搜索参数:', params);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Typography.Title level={4}>SearchInput 搜索输入</Typography.Title>\n      <Typography.Paragraph style={{ margin: 0 }}>\n        输入停止 500ms 后自动写入筛选值并触发搜索；中文等输入法组合输入期间不会触发搜索，确认文本后才开始计时。按回车或点击搜索按钮会立即提交。 清空后也会在 500ms 后移除该筛选条件。\n      </Typography.Paragraph>\n      <FilterProvider value={filterValue} onChange={setFilterValue}>\n        <Flex gap={8} align=\"center\">\n          <SearchInput name=\"keyword\" label=\"关键词\" placeholder=\"请输入关键词\" style={{ width: 320 }} allowClear />\n          <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={handleSearch}>\n            查看搜索参数\n          </Button>\n        </Flex>\n      </FilterProvider>\n      <Flex gap={8}>\n        <span>当前筛选值:</span>\n        <pre style={{ margin: 0, background: '#f5f5f5', padding: 8, borderRadius: 4, flex: 1 }}>{JSON.stringify(filterValue, null, 2)}</pre>\n      </Flex>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<SearchInputExample />);\n\n",

    packageName: "antd",
    component: component_3

    code: "const { FilterValueDisplay } = _ReactFilter;\nconst { Flex } = antd;\nconst { useState } = React;\n\nconst FilterValueDisplayExample = () => {\n  const [filterValue, setFilterValue] = useState([\n    { name: 'keyword', label: '关键词', value: { label: 'React', value: 'React' } },\n    { name: 'status', label: '状态', value: { label: '已完成', value: 'completed' } },\n    { name: 'amount', label: '金额', value: { label: '100-500万', value: [100, 500] } },\n    {\n      name: 'tags',\n      label: '标签',\n      value: [\n        { label: '前端', value: 'frontend' },\n        { label: 'React', value: 'react' }\n      ]\n    }\n  ]);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <h4>已选筛选条件展示</h4>\n      <FilterValueDisplay\n        value={filterValue}\n        onChange={setFilterValue}\n        extraExpand={\n          <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#999' }}>\n            共 {filterValue.length} 项\n          </span>\n        }\n      />\n      <Flex gap={8}>\n        <span>当前值:</span>\n        <pre style={{ margin: 0, background: '#f5f5f5', padding: 8, borderRadius: 4, flex: 1 }}>\n          {JSON.stringify(filterValue, null, 2)}\n        </pre>\n      </Flex>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<FilterValueDisplayExample />);\n\n",

    title: "弹出层筛选",
    description: "使用 PopoverItem 组件实现弹出层形式的筛选项，支持文本输入、数字输入、下拉选择和数值范围等多种交互形式",
    code: "const { PopoverItem } = _ReactFilter;\nconst { Input, InputNumber, Space, Select, Radio, Flex } = antd;\nconst { useState } = React;\n\nconst PopoverItemExample = () => {\n  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState(null);\n  const [numberValue, setNumberValue] = useState(null);\n  const [selectValue, setSelectValue] = useState(null);\n  const [rangeValue, setRangeValue] = useState(null);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={24}>\n      <h4>弹出层筛选组件示例</h4>\n      <Flex wrap gap={16}>\n        {/* 输入框筛选 */}\n        <PopoverItem\n          label=\"文本输入\"\n          value={inputValue}\n          onChange={setInputValue}\n        >\n          {({ value, onChange }) => (\n            <Input\n              style={{ width: 240 }}\n              placeholder=\"请输入文本\"\n              value={value?.value || ''}\n              onChange={(e) => onChange(\n                e.target.value ? { label: e.target.value, value: e.target.value } : null\n              )}\n            />\n          )}\n        </PopoverItem>\n\n        {/* 数字输入筛选 */}\n        <PopoverItem\n          label=\"数字输入\"\n          value={numberValue}\n          onChange={setNumberValue}\n          onValidate={(val) => val?.value !== undefined}\n        >\n          {({ value, onChange }) => (\n            <InputNumber\n              style={{ width: 240 }}\n              placeholder=\"请输入数字\"\n              value={value?.value}\n              onChange={(val) => onChange(\n                val !== null ? { label: String(val), value: val } : null\n              )}\n            />\n          )}\n        </PopoverItem>\n\n        {/* 下拉选择筛选 */}\n        <PopoverItem\n          label=\"状态选择\"\n          value={selectValue}\n          onChange={setSelectValue}\n        >\n          {({ value, onChange }) => (\n            <Select\n              style={{ width: 240 }}\n              placeholder=\"请选择状态\"\n              value={value?.value}\n              onChange={(val, option) => onChange({\n                value: val,\n                label: option?.label || val\n              })}\n              options={[\n                { value: 'active', label: '激活' },\n                { value: 'inactive', label: '未激活' },\n                { value: 'pending', label: '待处理' }\n              ]}\n            />\n          )}\n        </PopoverItem>\n\n        {/* 数字范围筛选 */}\n        <PopoverItem\n          label=\"数值范围\"\n          value={rangeValue}\n          onChange={setRangeValue}\n          onValidate={(val) => {\n            const range = val?.value;\n            return !(range && range[0] !== undefined && range[1] !== undefined && range[1] < range[0]);\n          }}\n        >\n          {({ value, onChange }) => (\n            <Space.Compact>\n              <InputNumber\n                style={{ width: 100 }}\n                placeholder=\"最小值\"\n                value={value?.value?.[0]}\n                onChange={(val) => onChange({\n                  label: `${val || '?'}-${value?.value?.[1] || '?'}`,\n                  value: [val, value?.value?.[1]]\n                })}\n              />\n              <Input\n                style={{ width: 30, textAlign: 'center', borderLeft: 0, borderRight: 0 }}\n                placeholder=\"~\"\n                disabled\n              />\n              <InputNumber\n                style={{ width: 100 }}\n                placeholder=\"最大值\"\n                value={value?.value?.[1]}\n                onChange={(val) => onChange({\n                  label: `${value?.value?.[0] || '?'}-${val || '?'}`,\n                  value: [value?.value?.[0], val]\n                })}\n              />\n            </Space.Compact>\n          )}\n        </PopoverItem>\n      </Flex>\n\n      <Flex vertical gap={8}>\n        <h5>当前值:</h5>\n        <pre style={{ margin: 0, background: '#f5f5f5', padding: 12, borderRadius: 4 }}>\n          {JSON.stringify({\n            文本输入: inputValue,\n            数字输入: numberValue,\n            状态选择: selectValue,\n            数值范围: rangeValue\n          }, null, 2)}\n        </pre>\n      </Flex>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<PopoverItemExample />);\n\n",
